REVIEW FAIL (code): Policy lock unreadable/non-directory probe handling — FR-004.
  WHERE: src/plugins/policy-lock.ts:55-57
  EXPECTED: Return undefined only when .gwrk/policy-lock.json is absent (ENOENT) without calling fs/promises readFile; wrap non-absence stat/read errors (EACCES, ENOTDIR, dangling symlink) in CommandError naming the tracked lock path and corrective repair guidance.
  ACTUAL: lstatSync(file, { throwIfNoEntry: false }) executes outside try/catch and throws raw Error (ENOTDIR when .gwrk is a file; EACCES when .gwrk has mode 000) instead of CommandError with repair guidance.
  FIX: Guard the lstatSync call in try/catch (returning undefined only on undefined/ENOENT and throwing CommandError(`Cannot read ${file}. Review the tracked lock and restore a readable file.`) on any other error). Apply and pass the preserved regression test in .runs/review-regressions-phase03-20261118T1921Z.patch.

tasks.description:
MODIFY src/plugins/skill-runtime.ts. Apply pins at feature 044's policy resolution boundary. FR-004.. Tests: src/plugins/skill-runtime.test.ts

REVIEW FAIL (code): Exact parsed manifest digest verification — FR-004.
  WHERE: src/plugins/skill-runtime.ts:245-263; src/plugins/loader.ts:83-86,301-307
  EXPECTED: PluginLoader.listEnforcementCandidates preserves the original parsed manifest in sourceManifest separately from computed enablement metadata (disabled), and resolveEffectivePolicy passes candidates directly to verifyProjectPolicyLock so exact manifest digests are enforced.
  ACTUAL: PluginLoader overwrites manifest with { ...manifest, disabled } without attaching sourceManifest, and skill-runtime.ts works around it by checking both computePolicySkillDigest(c.manifest, c.content) and withoutDisabled. As reproduced on disk, resolveEffectivePolicy silently accepts a pin hashed with disabled:false against a manifest.yaml omitting disabled, and silently accepts a pin hashed without disabled against a manifest.yaml explicitly declaring disabled:false. Also leaves unused CommandError import at src/plugins/skill-runtime.ts:20.
  FIX: Add sourceManifest?: EnforcementSkillManifest to LoadedEnforcementCandidate and set sourceManifest: manifest in PluginLoader.listEnforcementCandidates before attaching computed disabled. Remove the dual-hash workaround in src/plugins/skill-runtime.ts:245-263 (and unused CommandError import at line 20) and pass candidates directly to verifyProjectPolicyLock. Apply and pass the preserved regression tests in .runs/review-regressions-phase03-20261118T1921Z.patch.
  GATE: specs/045-workflow-governance/gates/phase-03.sh (coverage hole: green gate missed real-disk disabled:false digest bypass)
  REF: plan.md Phase 3 > Files & Test Strategy (TR-008, TR-009); data-model.md#project-policy-lock; evidence/phase03-lock-reader-preparation.md
